bash/alias:
if function _alias_lens_catalog_handoff {
  :
  builtin local _alias_lens_readonly_functions _alias_lens_readonly_line _alias_lens_readonly_name
  _alias_lens_readonly_functions="$(builtin declare -Fr)" || return 1
  while IFS= builtin read -r _alias_lens_readonly_line; do
    _alias_lens_readonly_name="${_alias_lens_readonly_line##* }"
    if builtin test "$_alias_lens_readonly_name" = 'demo'; then return 1; fi
  done <<< "$_alias_lens_readonly_functions"
  builtin alias demo='printf synthetic' || return 1
}; then
if \_alias_lens_catalog_handoff; then
  builtin unset -f _alias_lens_catalog_handoff
  builtin true
else
  builtin unset -f _alias_lens_catalog_handoff
  builtin false
fi
else
  builtin false
fi
bash/empty:
if function _alias_lens_catalog_handoff {
  :
}; then
if \_alias_lens_catalog_handoff; then
  builtin unset -f _alias_lens_catalog_handoff
  builtin true
else
  builtin unset -f _alias_lens_catalog_handoff
  builtin false
fi
else
  builtin false
fi
bash/function:
if function _alias_lens_catalog_handoff {
  :
  builtin local _alias_lens_readonly_functions _alias_lens_readonly_line _alias_lens_readonly_name
  _alias_lens_readonly_functions="$(builtin declare -Fr)" || return 1
  while IFS= builtin read -r _alias_lens_readonly_line; do
    _alias_lens_readonly_name="${_alias_lens_readonly_line##* }"
    if builtin test "$_alias_lens_readonly_name" = 'demo'; then return 1; fi
  done <<< "$_alias_lens_readonly_functions"
  if builtin eval 'demo() {
 printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$1"
}
'; then builtin unalias -- 'demo' 2>/dev/null || :; else return 1; fi
}; then
if \_alias_lens_catalog_handoff; then
  builtin unset -f _alias_lens_catalog_handoff
  builtin true
else
  builtin unset -f _alias_lens_catalog_handoff
  builtin false
fi
else
  builtin false
fi
